option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value:
set -euo pipefail
echo '==> Démarrage PostgreSQL' docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
echo '==> Application des migrations' .venv/bin/python -m alembic upgrade head
cleanup() { echo '==> Arrêt API / worker' kill "${API_PID:-}" "${WORKER_PID:-}" 2>/dev/null || true wait "${API_PID:-}" "${WORKER_PID:-}" 2>/dev/null || true }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
echo '==> Démarrage du worker' .venv/bin/python -m app.workers.document_worker & WORKER_PID=$!
echo '==> Démarrage de l API' .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload & API_PID=$!
wait -n "$WORKER_PID" "$API_PID"
